headword: {皇室典範|こうしつてんぱん}

definitions.explanation: The Japanese law that governs the Imperial Family: who succeeds to the throne, who belongs to the family, and how it is organized. The current law dates from 1947. Often shortened to {典範|てんぱん} in news writing.

examples.japanese: {皇室典範|こうしつてんぱん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To revise the Imperial House Law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇位|こうい}→皇位：14867_koui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{皇室典範|こうしつてんぱん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: Succession to the throne is set out in the Imperial House Law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧をめぐって、{典範|てんぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Revision of the Imperial House Law is being debated over whether to allow a female emperor.

notes:
A news and politics word. The current law allows only male descendants in the male line to succeed, which is why its revision is a recurring topic.
